title: Carbon: visible technical operations
summary: Make operational scope legible with aligned records, a stable toolbar, visible filters and explicit batch selection.
use_when: An operator must find, compare and act on many structured records while preserving filter and selection scope.
avoid_when: A single simple decision or a brand narrative needs more explanation than simultaneous record comparison.
